Qilin acts like an intelligent engineering advisor.
It continuously studies everything happening inside the project and predicts future
engineering problems before they become expensive.

Qilin is an AI-powered engineering intelligence platform that collects information from
software repositories, issue trackers, pull requests, continuous integration pipelines, static
analysis reports, documentation, and testing systems.
The platform transforms these different software engineering artifacts into a unified
knowledge base representing the entire software development lifecycle.
Artificial intelligence models analyze this information to estimate the overall health of the
project, predict future engineering risks, identify bug-prone modules, estimate technical
debt growth, detect developer knowledge bottlenecks, predict sprint completion risks,
estimate merge conflict probability, and recommend preventive actions.
